title: Figures 22-24: SEP SiC/SiC panel, UBE Tyranno cloth, porous nickel nose tip test
description: Three color photographs: a ribbed gray silicon carbide panel on display ("Figure 22. This 1988 SEP Bordeaux SiC/SiC Panel Could Sustain Temperatures of up to 3,000 °F."); a gold-colored bar marked "GOLD" resting on woven fiber cloth ("Figure 23. UBE Corporation's Tyranno Cloth. The cloth was used industrially in Japan."); and a brightly glowing nose tip in an arc-heated test ("Figure 24. A Porous Nickel Tip Oozing Water. This test lasted 4,300 seconds before the arc heater cathode—not the nose tip—failed.").
